title: Console agent conversation timeline and reply composer
description: Expose agent conversation state, summaries, redacted logs, run metadata, and a normal-comment composer that resumes awaiting Codex sessions. Add realtime plus Git-backed refresh.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live-router validation found a concrete gap after PR #296: router.conversation records, raw agent output, and recovery metadata are durable on kanbus/router-state, but the current console issue API/UI exposes only ordinary issue comments. The preserved Review run for kbs-4c719898 is visible as a normal report, but there is no Agent conversation timeline, redacted log expander, run metadata, or comment-to-resume path yet. This must be implemented and verified against a real preserved run before transparent delegation is considered smooth.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Substantially delivered; closing with one small follow-up filed. Shipped: router.conversation events are merged into the issue event history by the Rust console backend (rust/src/bin/console_local.rs merge_router_conversation_events) and the Node server (apps/console/server/index.ts); the issue detail renders provider, lifecycle, session, branch and an expandable Redacted agent output (redaction in both runtimes); the comment composer, status control and blocked-agent reply resume shipped in PR #351 on top of the write API in #344; the console refreshes from SSE snapshots every 15 seconds. Verified against the real preserved run kbs-4c7198 through the console API: it returns its started, agent_turn (with log and session) and four recovered conversation events. Not shown yet: the event's message/summary and claim, revision and worktree metadata, tracked in the new follow-up story. The rendered timeline itself was not confirmed visually because the browser pane kept hiding.
